name: Sweetmaker
source:
Sweetland is a world powered by love and sweet flavors. It’s thanks to Sweetland that all desserts bring happiness to other worlds. The current princess of Cake Kingdom, Princess Cheesecake, is ready to take over for her parents and bring the joy of desserts to others.

But before she can take the throne she must choose a topping to rule beside her. It’s only through a partnership of flavor that she can understand how to rule with others in mind. She has her choice between four princes from The Federation of Fruit and The Sauce Empire. 

By spending time with them Princess Cheesecake learns about the depth of flavor and the happiness love can bring others.

[From [url=https://lovexlab.itch.io/sweetmaker-demo]itch.io[/url]]
